_doc: Placemark classification rules. Rules are evaluated in order: hub -> cluster_boundary -> region -> other_categories -> unclassified. A placemark matches a 'fields' rule only if every listed ExtendedData field is present. Set 'inferred': true on rules that rely on interpretation rather than an explicit attribute, so the UI and report can label them.

region.mapping_note: Inferred: region polygons named South/East/North are matched to the hub 'Line' attribute values southern_hyd/eastern_hyd/northern_hyd by compass direction.

other_categories.label: Demand hotspot (PMF plus-code cell)
other_categories.note: Points carrying USERS/DELS/DEL_BUCKET demand metrics per Plus Code cell.

other_categories.label: Screening record (contains personal names - excluded from maps and exports)
Competitor live location (Snabbit)
other_categories.note: Folder name 'Snabbit live pluscodes'; Snabbit is listed as a competitor in the hub Competition Intelligence attributes.

clustering_fallback._doc: Used only when hubs carry no cluster attribute and no cluster boundary polygons exist.
